name: Planet
oneLine: Earth-imaging constellation company; near-black canvas, geometric Gotham, imagery and teal-outlined data doing the talking.

palette.note: Hero and 3D-terrain section canvas, near-pure black so imagery glows
Blue-black band behind the 'Don't just capture change.' statement
Slate testimonial section holding the customer video cards
Nearly all type (121 nodes) is white on dark; also the light news-card band under the hero
Teal ring in the logo, 1px outline on 'Contact Sales' / 'Learn More', hairline under the nav
Brighter cyan for chart lines, AOI boxes on the terrain, and 'NEW' tag fills

type.note: 93px bold all-caps 'UNDETECTED' hero word with tight tracking; 64px+ bold sentence-case statements ('Don't just capture change.')
Light ~36px sentence-case subhead under the hero; Gotham fallback, same geometric skeleton
12px/500 is the dominant size: captions like 'Hood Canal, WA - 3 m PlanetScope', uppercase industry tags ('CIVIL GOVERNMENT') with wide tracking
Green HUD readout burned into the mobile hero video (ID / LOA / BEAM / HDG / CLASS), terminal-style

layout: Left-aligned hero on a 114px inset: one giant word, two-line subhead, single outlined CTA; right two-thirds left empty for the background video.
Sections alternate as full-bleed colour bands (black, white card row, blue-black, slate) rather than dividers, each with one idea.
Centrepiece is an isometric 3D slab of Washington State imagery with teal AOI rectangles, flanked above by rounded image/chart cards with 2px teal borders.
motion: Hero word animates focus: 'UN' is rendered blurred and fading while 'DETECTED' is sharp, a blur-to-focus reveal that literalises change detection.
Hero is a single background video (videoCount 1) of satellite imagery with an overlaid HUD; desktop capture shows black before it loads.
(inferred) The 3D terrain slab and the flanking cards are scroll-driven, tilting into the isometric view as you scroll past.
(inferred) 'Don't just capture change. / Act on it.' reveals line by line on scroll.
interactions: Mega-menu nav with chevron dropdowns (Constellations, Products, Industries...).
Customer testimonial cards with play overlays open video; tag dots filter by industry.
Outlined pill buttons that likely fill teal on hover.
steal: Blur-to-focus word reveal for our hero: render 'ANOMALY' with the letters out of focus, snapping sharp to show detection.
Isometric 'data slab' with outlined regions: tilt a long telemetry channel strip in 3D on the Results section and box the detected anomaly windows in a single accent outline.
Small 12px captions under every figure stating source and resolution (e.g. 'ESA Mission 1 - channel 41 - 30 s sampling') across all charts.
leave: The marketing card row of webinars/TED talks right under the hero breaks the cinematic mood; our research page should keep the hero followed directly by the method.
Generic talking-head testimonial videos; they look stock and add nothing for ML reviewers.
